editorial:
Imagine being locked up in a New York jail and then suddenly finding yourself in the middle of a massive prison break. That is exactly where you start with Detective James Knight. He is a tough guy who has seen it all, but things get weird when he faces off against the Christmas Bomber. This villain is a total fanatic who has followers dressed as Santa Claus, and they are turning the city into a war zone. The vibe is very gritty and dark, feeling like those old-school action movies where one man takes on a whole army to get his life back. You get the feeling that Knight is the only person capable of stopping this madness.

What really works here is the non-stop energy and the fights. The action is straightforward and hits hard, though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable. If you love seeing a strong lead character kick some bad guy butt, you will have a blast. It is not a deep movie, but it is a great way to spend a Friday night.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Knight tracks down the Christmas Bomber and his crew to stop the remaining attacks. After a series of brutal fights, Knight manages to take out the bad guys and save the city from further bombs. He proves his loyalty and skill, which allows him to finally get his police badge back. The movie ends with him returning to his role as a detective, having earned his redemption through force.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tough-guy action and revenge stories.
